label: EXPLORATORY / DEVELOPMENT_ONLY / NOT_CONFIRMATORY_EVIDENCE — engineering readiness, NOT a truth ranking
basis: pooled cross-evaluator agreement + resonance + no_relationship rate over V1 (54x2) and V2 (60x2) components; ranked by AGREEMENT/robustness, not absolute score (V1 and V2 used different frozen scale calibrations)

relationship_types: no_relationship (cross-eval agreement 1.00 when shared — a trustworthy 'does-not-apply' signal)
opposition (agreement 0.79 when shared, 44 uses, avg resonance 55 — best substantive relationship)
tier_1_high_confidence.use: only where the bare word clearly OPPOSES an affliction mapping (virtue words) or clearly has NO relationship; both are the agreement-stable ends.

relationship_types: implication (105 uses, lowest score variance, but agreement only 0.54 — reliable ONLY as a weak/low-signal indicator, not for magnitude)
categories: virtue_calm (avg 57.3) and afflictive (48.5) resonate strongly but have the LOWEST cross-eval agreement (afflictive exact 0.40) — high signal, high disagreement
tier_2_promising_but_evaluator_sensitive.use: surface as a tentative reflection with an explicit confidence caveat; do not act on magnitude.

categories: concrete_object, animal_body_living, natural_action_abstract (low resonance; animal has the highest no_relationship rate 0.24)
tier_3_experimental.note: the ego/ahaṃkāra-family mappings (j, ṅ, gh) drew UNANIMOUS no_relationship/0 on the (body-part) words carrying them — stable at zero, but n=1 each.
